lines.en: label beachfive2:
scene mayapostcoitus1
: I’m sure Maya has...a perfectly reasonable explanation for not being here.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Maya 有……一个完全合理的理由不来这里。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you always give people the benefit of the doubt. I can’t do that, Ayane. I’ve been lied to too many times.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为你总是先往好处想别人。我做不到，Ayane。我被骗过太多次了。

lines.en: : That sort of thing wears a girl down, you know? And that’s why I think we need to be honest with one another.
lines.zh: : 那种事会消磨一个女孩，你懂吧？所以我觉得我们俩得对彼此诚实。

lines.en: : Let’s just...talk about something else for now.
lines.zh: : 我们……先聊点别的吧。

lines.en: : Better yet, let’s just sit in silence and play Mario Kart like real friends. No more talking until one of us has something funny to say.
lines.zh: : 不如这样，我们就安静地坐着打马里奥赛车，像真正的朋友那样。在有人说点好笑的话之前，谁也别开口。

lines.en: : So...you’ll be keeping your mouth shut forever?
lines.zh: : 所以……你这是要永远闭嘴了？

lines.en: : Things not to say while your opponent is wielding a red shell.
lines.zh: : 这种话可不该在对手手里握着红龟壳的时候说。

lines.en: : Holy shit...I needed that...
lines.zh: : 我操……我正需要这个……

lines.en: Today is Sunday, but I’m unsure of the current weather as a ghost showed up before I was able to step outside.
lines.zh: 今天是周日，但我不知道现在天气如何，因为我还没来得及出门，一个幽灵就出现了。

lines.en: It’s a different ghost than normal, but another one dead set on preventing me from moving on by creating a world where I can’t even open my eyes without wanting to close them anymore.
lines.zh: 那是个跟平时不同的幽灵，但同样是铁了心要阻止我往前走——它创造了一个世界，在这个世界里我连睁开眼都不想，只想再闭上。

lines.en: No matter how many times I try to block her out, she just keeps coming. And while I admire that sort of uncharacteristically headstrong tenacity, I can’t help but wish she was a little more absent.
lines.zh: 不管我多少次试图把她屏蔽掉，她还是不停地来。虽然我挺佩服这种一反常态的倔强，可我还是忍不住希望她能稍微消失一下。

lines.en: I can’t help but wish her tenacity only existed behind the scenes in a manner that would cause her to silently suffer while I reap the benefits of something that could only be called “divine punishment.”
lines.zh: 我忍不住希望她的倔强只存在于幕后，让她在沉默中受苦，而我则收割某种只能称之为「神罚」的东西的好处。

lines.en: I’m sure that’s a little selfish of me- but I’m a selfish person. And I’m sure it’s what she would want as well since it’s that exact thing that kept us together for as long as we were.
lines.zh: 我知道这有点自私——可我就是个自私的人。而且我敢肯定这也正是她想要的，因为正是那一点让我们在一起那么久。

lines.en: Now here I lie with a corpse that bears her scent — that horrid hint of watermelon and the gaping hole it drills into my throat as it pours in through my sinuses.
lines.zh: 现在我躺在这里，身边是一具带着她气味的身体——那股可怕的西瓜味，从我的鼻窦涌进来，在我喉咙里钻出一个大洞。

lines.en: I try to block that out too, but every once in a while I’ll accidentally feel her hair on my skin. Or her fingertips. Or her mouth — and each one gnaws away at every fiber of my being and reminds me of what I’ve lost.
lines.zh: 我也试着屏蔽那个，可每隔一阵子，我还是会不小心感觉到她的头发蹭在我皮肤上。或者她的指尖。或者她的嘴——而每一样都在啃噬我存在的每一根纤维，提醒我失去了什么。

lines.en: I know now the pain she must have felt. I can feel a trace of it each and every time I submit to her. And I will keep submitting to her because how can I not?
lines.zh: 我现在知道了她曾经感受到的痛。每一次我向她屈服，我都能感觉到一丝。而我会继续向她屈服，因为我怎么能不呢？

lines.en: If it looks like her and smells like her and speaks like her and loves like her, can I be forgiven for pretending it is her?
lines.zh: 如果它看起来像她、闻起来像她、说话像她、爱起来像她，那么我假装它就是她，能被原谅吗？

lines.en: Or would I be better off trying to let go of one more piece of me when I know it’s the only one I have left?
lines.zh: 还是说，当我知道那是我仅剩的最后一小块时，我最好还是试着再放掉一块自己？

lines.en: : You don’t know what time it is, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不知道现在几点了，是吧？

lines.en: : No, but I know you should probably leave before Ami’s sixth sense kicks in and we both wind up dead.
lines.zh: : 不知道，不过我知道你大概该走了，免得 Ami 的第六感发作，然后我们俩都得死。

lines.en: : I doubt she’ll actually come here. We were planning on meeting at Ayane’s place and that’s a decent way away. I’ll just have to answer a phone call or two.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑她真会来这儿。我们本来约好在 Ayane 家碰头，那儿离这儿挺远的。我只要接一两个电话就行。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus2

lines.zh: : 然后在我走之前你可以再干我一次。不过这次我在下面，我骑你骑累了，需要歇歇。

lines.en: : Just save it for next time. I can’t do any more today.
lines.zh: : 留到下次吧。今天我再也做不动了。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus3
: Sure you can. I know your limits. I’ve tested them probably ten thousand times.
lines.zh: : 你当然做得动。我知道你的极限。我大概测试过一万次了。

lines.en: : I’m just not feeling well, okay?
lines.zh: : 我就是不太舒服，好吗？

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus4

lines.zh: : 这是做完之后的抑郁又犯了？还是真的抑郁？因为有时候真分不清你是哪种。

lines.en: : Who even knows at this point?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢，到这个地步。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus5

: Well, whatever it is, can you knock it off? And I mean that in the most sincere way possible. I’ve just barely seen you at all lately and I don’t want what little time we do have to be all sad and...quiet.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管是什么，你能不能别这样了？我是真心实意地说这句话。我最近都没怎么见到你，我不想我们仅有的那点时间全是悲伤和……沉默。

lines.en: : Funny. It feels like not so long ago you were practically begging me to keep my mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。感觉不久前你还几乎是在求我闭嘴。

lines.en: : Uhh...when? I don’t remember that at all.
lines.zh: : 呃……什么时候？我完全不记得。

lines.en: : Yeah, you wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 是，你不会记得的。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus6
: Ahh, okay. You must be talking about Maya the time-traveler again. The one you fell in love with who then went back to the future to be all hot and cool over there.
lines.zh: : 啊，好吧。你肯定又在说那个时间旅行者 Maya 了。你爱上的那个，然后回了未来，在那边又辣又酷。

lines.en: : You know, that’s essentially cheating. Even if it is just a clone of me from another timeline or something. I can’t help but be a little offended, but honestly? I get it. I’d probably bang future Akira too.
lines.zh: : 你知道，那基本上算是出轨。哪怕那只是另一个时间线的我的克隆体什么的。我忍不住有点受伤，不过说实话？我理解。我也可能会去操未来的 Akira。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus7

lines.zh: : 或者过去的 Akira。我从来没跟同龄人上过床。也许我会更喜欢？

lines.zh: : 如果那个 Maya 的什么……在你身体里的某个地方呢？

lines.zh: : 你没听见我说的话吗？我刚说我从来没跟同龄人上过床。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus8

lines.zh: : 我是说她的记忆。我这几年来跟她一起创造的那些。在屋顶上的那些次……那些深夜跑腿，还有……她让我搬的那些奇怪的箱子。

lines.zh: Noriko 说 Maya 的记忆也许像我的一样被困在里面，那种说法要是真能成真，就太省事了。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus15

lines.zh: : 下次你一早就跑来这儿这个糟糕的决定时，我会记住的。

lines.en: : Sounds good. Does tomorrow work for you? I’ve got some spare time for a creampie or two before math. Where did I throw my bra? I thought- oh. Found it.

lines.en: : You’d show up even if I said no.

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus16

lines.zh: : 没错。因为不像某个人，我其实是个好人。

lines.en: : Well...mostly good. Good to you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大体上是好的。对你好。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus17

lines.zh: : 这么说来，技术上讲我是个坏人，因为我……没顾及别人的感受？我也不太确定。不过那不是我的错，因为我的老师也没教过我道德和伦理。

lines.en: : Yeah, you made that very apparent during the last Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 是啊，上次宿舍战争的时候你就表现得很明显了。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus19
She doesn’t even bother getting fully dressed before marching over to the kitchen and going through the cabinets.

lines.en: The way she moves alone is more than enough to make me believe she’s done this time and time before. But is this...really the way it was?
lines.zh: 光是她走路的姿态，就足够让我相信她做过这件事无数次了。可这……真的是过去的样子吗？

lines.en: Were we so accustomed to sneaking around that she developed the confidence needed to parade around my home with my cum still clinging to her thighs?

lines.en: This isn’t comfort — this is recklessness. This is the type of thing that I should be doing, not her.
lines.zh: 这不是自在——这是鲁莽。这种事该是我干的，不是她。

lines.en: She is stoic. Unmoving. Temperamental, but smart. She’s a creature of logic and habit but habits like these are...
lines.zh: 她冷静。不动如山。脾气古怪，但聪明。她是逻辑与习惯的生物，可像这样的习惯是……

lines.en: I barely recognize her...
lines.zh: 我几乎认不出她了……

lines.en: But still it...feels so familiar.
lines.zh: 可它还是……感觉那么熟悉。

lines.en: It’s so comforting that all I can think of doing is crawling back into bed. But even that thought is pushed back by the idea that she’d just crawl into it with me.
lines.zh: 熟悉到我唯一能想到的就是爬回床上。可就连这个念头，也被「她会跟着我爬进来」的想法压了回去。

lines.en: So despite being here in the life I’ve always wished for...all I wish is for its end. For her to close that fucking cabinet.

lines.zh: : 跟我最近做的梦比起来，那根本算不上怪。

lines.en: : Yeah, but we can talk about that later. It’s not really a thing I want to bring up when she’ll be back from the buffet any second now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过那个我们回头再聊。她马上就从自助餐那边回来了，我可不想当着她的面谈这个。

lines.en: : Your house has a buffet?
lines.zh: : 你家有自助餐？

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus24
: Not normally. But Geoffrey threw one together today since it’s the first time in a while I’ve had anyone over.
lines.zh: : 平时没有。不过 Geoffrey 今天临时弄了一个，因为我很久没带人回家了。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure Maya heads over soon. I don’t really want her here either.
lines.zh: : 我会让 Maya 尽快过去的。我也不太想让她待在这儿。

lines.en: : Wooooooooooow. Just hit it and quit it then. I see how it is.
lines.zh: : 哇哦哦哦哦哦哦哦。用完就甩是吧。我懂了。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus25
: Hey, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: : Do you want to come over too, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你也想过来吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t really know if-
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道该不该——

lines.en: : Not today. Like...maybe Friday night, though?
lines.zh: : 不是今天。比如……也许周五晚上？

lines.en: : I’ve been kind of...busy lately. With apocalypse stuff.
lines.zh: : 我最近有点……忙。忙着末日的事。

lines.en: : I know that’s probably the last thing on your mind right now given everything thats happened and whatnot, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道，考虑到发生过的一切之类的，这大概是你现在最不会去想的事，可是……

lines.en: : With you being mostly out of commission, Maya being completely out of commission, and Makoto just not really giving a shit...I’d feel weird if I just let things go on like “normal,” you know?
lines.zh: : 你基本已经不能行动了，Maya 也完全不能行动了，而 Makoto 根本就不在乎……如果我就这么让一切「照常」继续下去，我会觉得很别扭，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Somebody’s gotta do something. And, while they probably all suck, I did come up with a few ideas I’d like to run by you if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 总得有人做点什么。而且，虽然那些想法大概都很烂，但我确实想出了几个，如果可以的话想跟你商量一下。

lines.en: : Just you and me?
lines.zh: : 就你和我？

lines.en: : And Makoto if I can get her here. But, again, she doesn’t really seem to care.
lines.zh: : 如果我能把她叫来的话，还有 Makoto。不过再说一次，她看起来真的不在乎。

lines.en: : Friday?
lines.zh: : 周五？

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus26
: Only if you can make it. I don’t want to force anything on you if you’re still...getting over things.
lines.zh: : 只要你来得了就行。如果你还在……缓过来的话，我不想强求你什么。

lines.en: : I’ll be there. I’m sorry I haven’t been around, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我会去的。我很抱歉最近都没怎么露面，Ayane。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to apologize for, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没什么好道歉的，Sensei。

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus27
: Oh, wait. I’m supposed to call you “Dad” now.
lines.zh: : 哦，等等。我现在应该叫你「爸爸」才对。

lines.en: : Uhh...you’re supposed to do what?
lines.zh: : 呃……你应该叫我什么？

lines.en: scene mayapostcoitus28
: Nothing! Talk to you later, Dad! Love you, Dad! Bye, Dad!
lines.zh: : 没什么！回头聊，爸爸！爱你，爸爸！再见，爸爸！

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Was that Ayane calling you “Dad” just now?
lines.zh: : 刚才是 Ayane 在叫你「爸爸」吗？

lines.en: : I...guess so?
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？

lines.en: : Ew. Make her stop. I don’t like that.
lines.zh: : 恶心。让她别这么叫。我不喜欢。

lines.en: scene black
: Make her stop yourself when you get over there.
lines.zh: : 等你过去了自己让她别这么叫。

lines.en: : Can I at least eat first? Also, can you pay for my taxi? I spent the last of my money buying you this breakfast that you’re not going to eat.
lines.zh: : 我至少能先吃点东西吗？还有，你能付我的出租车钱吗？我把最后一点钱都花在给你买这份你不会吃的早餐上了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ll pay for your taxi.
lines.zh: : 好……我付你的出租车钱。

lines.en: I agree only because I want her out of here as soon as possible.
lines.zh: 我答应下来，只是因为我想让她尽快离开这儿。

lines.en: This house is haunted — and I can’t stand being alone inside of it anymore.
lines.zh: 这栋房子闹鬼——而我再也无法忍受独自待在里面了。

lines.en: $ beachfive2 = True
$ maya_love = 0
Maya’s affection has been reset to 0!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度已重置为 0！

lines.en: It’s time to start over, FUCKER.
lines.zh: 该重新开始了，混蛋。

lines.en: $ maya_love += 1
Maya’s affection has NOW increased to [maya_love]! But affection is just an arbitrary concept used to display how close you are to someone!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度现在提升到了 [maya_love]！不过好感度只是一个用来显示你跟某人有多亲近的、随意的概念！

lines.en: She’s growing on you again! You love the scent of watermelon!
lines.zh: 她又在你心里生长起来了！你喜欢西瓜的味道！

lines.en: You have lost ¥4,000!
